title: Starla RIPE Atlas Probe
description: Health, measurements and result uploads for Starla RIPE Atlas probes.

panels.title: Controller
panels.description: Whether the probe holds an SSH session to a RIPE Atlas controller. With several probes selected, shows the worst.

panels.title: Results lost
panels.description: Share of measurement results produced in the time range that were dropped before upload: queue overflow, too many failed upload attempts, or older than max_result_age.

panels.title: Upload success
panels.description: Share of upload batches the controller accepted in the time range. A failed batch is requeued whole, so a low rate here turns into lost results.

panels.title: Measurement success
panels.description: Share of measurement runs in the time range that completed rather than failed.

panels.title: Scheduled tasks
panels.description: Measurement tasks currently scheduled on the probe.

panels.title: Upload queue
panels.description: Results waiting for the next upload cycle. Sampled after each enqueue and upload; the queue holds 10000 by default and drops the oldest when full.

panels.title: Measurements run
panels.description: Measurement runs, completed or failed, in the time range.

panels.title: Results dropped
panels.description: Results dropped in the time range.

panels.title: Upload batches failed
panels.description: Upload batches rejected, timed out or rate limited in the time range.

panels.title: Measurements failed
panels.description: Measurement runs that failed in the time range.

panels.title: Controller connects
panels.description: Connection attempts to the registration and controller servers in the time range. One per probe start is normal; more means the session keeps dropping.

panels.title: Exporter
panels.description: Whether Prometheus can scrape the probe's metrics endpoint.

panels.title: Controller session
panels.description: SSH session to the RIPE Atlas controller, per probe.

panels.title: Runs by type
panels.description: Measurement runs per minute, completed or failed.

panels.title: Failures by type
panels.description: Failed measurement runs per minute.

panels.title: Failure rate by type
panels.description: Share of runs of each type that failed in the time range.

targets.expr: (sum by (msm_type) (increase(starla_measurements_failed_total{instance=~"$instance", msm_type=~"$msm_type"}[$__range])) or 0 * sum by (msm_type) (increase(starla_measurement_duration_seconds_count{instance=~"$instance", msm_type=~"$msm_type"}[$__range]))) / sum by (msm_type) (increase(starla_measurement_duration_seconds_count{instance=~"$instance", msm_type=~"$msm_type"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Measurement mix
panels.description: Runs per measurement type in the time range.

panels.title: Commands received by type
panels.description: Measurement commands received from the controller in the time range. A command schedules a measurement, which may run many times, so this does not add up to runs. The controller calls TLS measurements sslcert.

panels.title: Mean duration by type
panels.description: Mean wall-clock time per run, completed or failed. The mean comes from the histogram's sum and count, so it is exact even above the top bucket.

panels.title: Duration distribution
panels.description: Run durations for the selected types. The top bucket is 120 s, so anything slower lands in +Inf.

panels.title: Result flow
panels.description: Results produced by measurement runs against results dropped before upload, per minute.

panels.title: Upload batches
panels.description: Upload batches per minute. The probe drains the whole queue into one POST each cycle (every 60 s by default).

panels.title: Upload success (30m)
panels.description: Share of upload batches accepted over a rolling 30 minutes.

panels.title: Upload latency
panels.description: Time from opening the tunnel stream to the controller's reply, for accepted batches only.

panels.title: Upload queue and scheduler
panels.description: Results waiting for upload, and measurement tasks scheduled.
